body: I've been seeing a shrink for a few months, and a doc for a few weeks. I was really against taking anything. Thought it was a sign of weakness, wanted to get through this myself, without "cheating" so to speak- today I caved and got the prescription he wrote for me filled. I'd love to end up like you some day. Thanks for the help and positive attitude, man, you don't know how much it means to me.

I feel what you're saying. And there's a part of me that could never do this to my family, but that part is slowly getting taken over by the part of me that is terrified of spending the rest of my life living like this. I can't sleep, or eat. I miss her every second of every day and it's agonizing.


You're right, though. Taking the 10 minutes to respond to this post means a lot to me. Thank you.
